scope: Incremental completion from n<=54 to n<=56; full-projective, full-row-rank generalised triorthogonal matrices, exact d_Z>=3, unrestricted intrinsic outputs, CNOT+S equivalence, Pareto objectives (n,S) at fixed output and exact distance. Includes all logical dimensions, not only q=5.
units: Measured user plus system CPU seconds; core-hours divide by 3600. Queue and transfer waiting are not CPU work.
assumptions: The deterministic raw-lift samples are used as if representative within each selected core after inverse-orbit-size weighting. Sixteen lifts per core are too few for statistical precision.
Within each sampled quadratic-nullity stratum, the sampled marked-orbit-mass-weighted rate represents unsampled cores in that stratum.
Unsampled nullity-3 and nullity-4 strata use the largest observed per-marked-orbit hard-support rate, separately in dimensions 15 and 16. This is a planning proxy, not an upper bound.

No high-quotient tail was observed in the sampled nullity-0/1 cores or the other contraction routes. The base model does not invent a rate there. This does not prove absence: undetected families, including later seed additions, are a major model risk.
Mean timings for the 12 dimension-15 and four dimension-16 completed full-enumeration keys are carried over to new hard keys. Later faster profile-presence runs are not substituted for those timings.

Affine point-orbit reduction and removal of Pareto-dominated redundant zero columns precede expensive logical enumeration. Direction orbits, not physical directions, are used when converting marked orbit counts.
The old ordinary-filter projection is retained only as a coarse background allowance. Its deterministic source populations and sampling uncertainties are not newly certified counts.

An additional allowance equal to the modelled filter work covers source generation and affine classification, other logical dimensions and higher distances, repaired primitive branches, validation, and CPU spent on retries. This factor of two is an engineering assumption, not a measured overhead or a rigorous bound.
No unproved nonexistence theorem or unmeasured new algorithmic acceleration is assumed. Higher-dimensional logical closure must still be performed in an actual classification.
